about.text: A viscous, salted, sour milk of Colombia’s Caribbean coast, made from raw milk that sours by itself and eaten with arepas and boiled yuca. Its name is the Spanish word for whey, but it is a soured whole milk.

facts.v: Cauca study: L. paracasei and L. lactis at 30:70 or 40:60 gave least syneresis
Yeasts rise early, enterobacteria fall, lactic acid bacteria dominate by about 24 h (Cueto et al. 2007)
Bolívar, Sucre, Córdoba and Cesar on the Caribbean coast
Viscous, salted; eaten with arepa, yuca or bollo
Mainly a dressing or sauce, for example with arroz de lisa in Barranquilla
